 Janardan Reddy ...... Petitioner

sentences.text:
Versus
 1. The State of Jharkhand
 2. Pinky Kumari

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
-----
For the Petitioner : Mr. Kaustav Roy, Advocate For the State : Md. Azeemuddin, A.P.P.

For the O.P.
No.2 : Mrs. Pinki Kumari, Advocate .....
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Peterbar P.S. Case No. 60 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No. 456 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498A, 323, 341, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and u/s 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that matter has been settled at mediation center,
JHALSA.
As a matter of first installment, demand draft of Rs. 3,50,000/- (Rs. Three Lacs Fifty Thousand) is being delivered in favour of opposite party no.2.
Petitioner undertakes to comply the other terms and conditions, hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned A.P.P. assisted with learned counsel for the informant has not opposed the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner.
Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation coupled with materials on record, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned SDJM, Bermo at Tenughat in connection with Peterbar P.S. Case No. 60 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No. 456 of 2022 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
